seg.seg_note: Four segments from FY2016 (post-Exelis reorganisation): Communication Systems, Space and Intelligence Systems, Electronic Systems, Critical Networks. Corporate lines as printed in the release: unallocated corporate expense (78) [includes the +101 net liability reduction for post-employment benefit plans], amortization of intangible assets from the Exelis acquisition (132) and corporate eliminations (3); the 10-K segment note combines the first two as unallocated corporate expense (210). Critical Networks includes the $367m CapRock impairment. Aerostructures (sold 8-Apr-2016) is in Electronic Systems; HCS (sold 1-Jul-2015) is in corporate. Segment orders / backlog are not given by segment.

ngaap.guidance: FY2017 (initial): GAAP income from continuing operations $5.53 to $5.73 per diluted share; non-GAAP $5.70 to $5.90 (excluding estimated acquisition-related items of $.17); revenue $7.11 to $7.33 billion.
ngaap.notes: Non-GAAP income from continuing operations / EPS excludes the CapRock goodwill and other asset impairment (367), the net liability reduction for post-employment benefit plans (-101), the net gain on sale of Aerostructures (-10, in non-operating income), integration and other Exelis acquisition-related costs (115, including 11 of inventory step-up amortization per the 10-K), and segment (42) and corporate (6) restructuring; total pre-tax 419, tax (49), after-tax 370 = $2.95 per share (only the after-tax total is given per share). Amortization of Exelis intangibles (132) is NOT excluded. Free cash flow = operating cash flow less net capital expenditures. Fourth-quarter non-GAAP segment operating income: Communication Systems 120, Electronic Systems 73, Critical Networks 81.

notes: is.lines_raw = 10-K statement of income (first column) followed by the earnings-release condensed statement lines (prefixed "[Q4 release ...]"), which add dividends per share and weighted average shares; mapped keys use the 10-K. is.op_income is computed (sales - cogs - sga - other operating lines); the statement of income prints no operating income line. bs.tl is computed (total current liabilities + total non-current liabilities); not printed. cf.pension_contrib and cf.pension_income are as presented in the cash flow statement (pension income is a negative non-cash adjustment). is.nci is signed as a deduction (negative = loss attributable to noncontrolling interests added back). bs.st_debt = Short-term debt + Current portion of long-term debt (sum). cf.da = sum of the depreciation / amortization lines where split. cf.divest = sum of the proceeds-from-sale lines (businesses, discontinued operations, asset group, adjustments). In the FY2016 10-K the Exelis intangible amortization (132) is a separate cash flow line and is included in cf.da (229 + 132 = 361) and cf.amort_acq. FY2016 as later re-presented (FY2017 10-K) moves CapRock and government IT services to discontinued operations: revenue 5,992, income from continuing operations 611, EPS 4.87. Self-checks: all pass.
